title: Passage ETA Margin vs Forecast Change
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marineweather:forecast route=passage
| stats min(eta_margin_hours) as min_margin, avg(wind_shift_kts) as avg_shift, count as forecasts by route_name
| sort min_margin
description: Shows which planned passages have the least ETA buffer once forecast changes are factored in.
value: Margin matters because a tight passage plan becomes stressful fast when the forecast moves against you.
implementation: Ingest marine-forecast snapshots tagged to routes; compare ETA margin and forecast change by passage.
visualization: Route table of minimum ETA margin and average forecast shift.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which passages are starting to lose their comfort margin as the forecast changes.
